Kill [[Urgoz]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Urgoz in [[Urgoz's Warren]].
* *BONUS* Kill Urgoz in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 7,500 [[Allegiance rank|Kurzick faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Urgoz's_Warren#Walkthrough|Urgoz's Warren]] mission.
